description: Calculates Cyprus Capital Gains Tax on an immovable property disposal using 2025 or 2026 rules, including CPI indexation, year-specific lifetime exemptions, the 20% CGT rate and the 0.4% property transfer fee. Use for Cyprus capital-gains tax on an immovable-property sale. Obtain the actual acquisition price and year, disposal tax year, sale price and property type; ask for missing essentials. Tax-year rules default to 2026; supply 2025 for a disposal in that year. Currency defaults to EUR only as a modelling convention. Omission of isFirstDisposal means no lifetime exemption is claimed; do not infer eligibility.

acquisitionPrice.description: Purchase price in the original currency.

acquisitionYear.description: Calendar year the property was acquired.

agentFees.description: Estate agent / legal fees deducted from the sale price, EUR.

currency.description: EUR (default) or CYP for pre-2008 purchases (converted at 0.585274).

isFirstDisposal.description: Whether the lifetime first-disposal exemption is being claimed. Omission means no exemption is claimed.

propertyType.description: Drives the year-specific lifetime exemption: 2025 general/plot €17,086, qualifying main residence €85,430 and agricultural land €25,629; 2026 general/plot €30,000, qualifying main residence €150,000 and agricultural land €50,000; other €0.

salePrice.description: EUR amount. Supply the actual value when applicable; use 0 only when confirmed to be zero.

taxYear.description: Disposal tax year; defaults to the current 2026 rules and selects year-specific lifetime allowances.

name: calculate_cyprus_capital_gains
